entities.summary: Marvin Pierce Bush is an American businessman. He is a son of former U.S. President George H. W. Bush and First Lady Barbara Bush and the brother of George W. Bush, the late Robin Bush, Jeb Bush, Neil Bush, and Dorothy Bush Koch.
